stories.title: EU drafts oversight standards for sustainability reports
stories.summary: Corporate sustainability reports are facing increased scrutiny as the European Union drafts new oversight standards. The move aims to formalize the reporting process, ensuring that the documents companies produce are subject to a more rigorous and standardized level of review across the bloc.

stories.title: Bremenports adopts European SME standards for sustainability
stories.summary: Bremenports has published its tenth sustainability report, titled Responsibility for the Ports of Tomorrow. For the first time, the company prepared the document using the European Voluntary Sustainability Reporting Standard for SMEs. The report covers the 2024 and 2025 financial years for the port management firm.

stories.title: EU Commission proposes new sustainability assurance standards
stories.summary: The European Commission has launched a consultation on draft standards for the limited assurance of sustainability reporting. The initiative aims to support consistency under the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive. Companies must obtain independent external reviews for their disclosures, though some options for simplification remain under current initiatives.

stories.title: Wiley reports 28 percent emissions reduction since 2020
stories.summary: Wiley has released its fiscal 2026 sustainability report, claiming a 28 percent reduction in emissions since 2020. The company says it is driving trusted knowledge for a more responsible future. The full details of the report are currently unavailable to those without access to the server.

stories.title: Study warns of MSME exclusion from emissions reporting
stories.summary: A study by the Chintan Research Foundation suggests over 9 crore MSMEs could face compliance challenges as India advances Scope 3 emissions reporting. The report examines the preparedness of the value chain, noting that top-listed companies are already preparing for the Securities and Exchange Board of India requirements.

stories.title: NRBC Bank reports financed emissions
stories.summary: NRBC Bank has published its second sustainability report, titled Innovation Drives Impact. The 2025 document includes the bank's first assessment of financed emissions under the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials framework, which estimated the total at 74,818 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent for the reporting period.

stories.title: Deloitte survey finds shift in corporate sustainability
stories.summary: Deloitte Global’s 2026 survey of 2,100 C-suite leaders suggests corporate sustainability has entered a more disciplined phase. The report notes a shift from broad ambition to execution focused on ROI and technology. Sustainability remains a top priority, though the focus has moved toward measurable business value.

stories.title: Coca-Cola Bottling Albania targets carbon neutrality by 2030
stories.summary: Coca-Cola Bottling Albania reported a 3.4 percent revenue increase in its third sustainability report. The company claims 85 percent waste recovery and 31 percent self-produced energy. President Luca Busi stated the firm aims to become the first carbon neutral industrial company in Albania by 2030.

stories.title: Tenneco Clean Air India receives unsolicited ESG score
stories.summary: Tenneco Clean Air India has been assigned an ESG score of 62 by SES ESG Research. The company informed stock exchanges that it did not engage the rating provider for the assessment. The score was based entirely on publicly available data from the 2025-26 financial year.

stories.title: Juventus details sustainability reporting evolution
stories.summary: Juventus has released its latest consolidated sustainability statement, describing it as a primary tool for communicating ESG performance. The club states it has progressively structured its data collection and validation processes since 2013. The report outlines the club's ongoing efforts to manage and disclose its sustainability impacts.

stories.title: EU court rules carbon border mechanism is not a tax
stories.summary: The European Union's top court has rejected Poland's challenge against the carbon border adjustment mechanism. The court held that the measure is fundamentally environmental in nature rather than a tax. The full article is available to subscribers of the publication.

stories.title: China expands carbon market cooperation at COP31
stories.summary: China has launched an initiative with Türkiye and Ethiopia to strengthen international cooperation on carbon credits. The country also signed a memorandum of understanding with the International Emissions Trading Association to boost its domestic voluntary market. Both announcements were made during the COP31 conference in Antalya.

stories.title: COP31 opens with focus on carbon market implementation
stories.summary: The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference opened in Antalya with discussions on Article 6 of the Paris Agreement. No major new trading agreements were reached on the first day. Instead, participants focused on putting existing rules into practice and attracting funding for climate projects.

stories.title: Global Carbon Market Network launches at COP31
stories.summary: The Global Carbon Council announced the launch of the Global Carbon Market Network at COP31. The network joins an international coalition of financial institutions and exchanges. The council, headquartered in Doha, is the first independent carbon crediting standard established in the Global South.

stories.title: Climate finance pledges drop 70 percent
stories.summary: Public funding pledged to help developing countries tackle climate change has fallen by more than 70 percent in 2026, according to Carbon Brief. Most previous pledges expired in 2025. Only five nations have announced new multi-year commitments as major donors scale back their international climate efforts.

stories.title: Climate summit reports warn of warming
stories.summary: New reports at COP31 suggest the planet remains on track to warm nearly 5 degrees Fahrenheit by 2100. The European Union’s Copernicus service noted that warming has accelerated since the 2015 Paris agreement. The conference continues with discussions on green technology and urban resilience.

stories.summary: Greta Thunberg, 23, made her first appearance at UN climate talks in five years to tell delegates the planet is being killed by the same people claiming to offer rescue. She warned that no one is coming to save the world from environmental breakdown.

stories.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan on Thursday called on developed countries to take greater responsibility for cutting emissions and financing climate action, warning at the COP31 summit that failure to address the worsening climate crisis would leave future generations facing devastating consequences. stories.title: AI proposed for climate early warning systems
stories.summary: Delegates at COP31 were told that artificial intelligence should be used to enhance early warning systems for climate threats like glacial floods. Dr. Khalilur Rahman noted that speeches do not cool the planet, suggesting that AI-driven technology is the required action.

stories.title: Defra updates packaging rules for hospitality
stories.summary: Glass bottles sold directly from producers to pubs, restaurants and licensed venues will be exempt from Extended Producer Responsibility fees starting April 2027. The policy shifts financial responsibility for household packaging waste from councils to producers. The exemption applies only to specific hospitality supply chains.

stories.title: Climate data remains absent from boardroom decisions
stories.summary: British executives report high concern regarding climate change but frequently exclude environmental metrics from corporate dashboards. Research finds that utilities and financial institutions often lack the foundational data required to assess infrastructure risks. Boards acknowledge the threat while continuing to prioritize financial and artificial intelligence insights.

stories.title: CleanMax plans $5.3 billion project for AI power
stories.summary: CleanMax plans to invest $5.3 billion in a wind, solar and pumped-hydro project in Andhra Pradesh. The development aims to supply 2 gigawatts of power to a planned AI computing facility. The company signed a memorandum of understanding with the state government on November 12.

stories.title: Shell reports methane reduction at Australian gas assets
stories.summary: Shell reduced methane emissions at its QGC natural gas business by approximately 50 percent between 2016 and the end of 2025. The company attributes the decline to a combination of satellite monitoring, drone surveys and maintenance changes. Total group-wide methane emissions fell 78 percent over the same period.

stories.title: Amazon launches equity-free sustainability accelerator
stories.summary: Amazon is opening applications in January 2027 for a global accelerator focused on material science, energy and manufacturing. The program offers no equity stakes to participants. Finalists may see their technologies adopted across Amazon Web Services, Amazon Devices and the company's private brand retail operations.

stories.title: CleanMax signs 50,000 crore MoU with Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: CleanMax has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to invest 50,000 crore in clean energy. The company plans to develop 3 gigawatts of wind, solar, and pumped hydro capacity to power an AI compute factory. The factory is still waiting.

stories.title: Google Cloud buys 10 million liters of sustainable aviation fuel
stories.summary: Google Cloud has partnered with logistics firm DSV to secure 10 million liters of sustainable aviation fuel for its air freight operations. The companies described the deal as a pilot that lays the groundwork for a broader sustainability collaboration. Air travel remains a difficult place to be sustainable.

stories.title: Tata Power reports record quarterly profit
stories.summary: Tata Power reported a record quarterly profit of 1,652 crore for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, a 33 percent increase from the previous year. Revenue rose 26 percent to 19,886 crore, driven by growth in renewable energy, grid expansion, and electric vehicle infrastructure. Growth is becoming a habit.

stories.title: Asda exceeds target to halve operational carbon emissions
stories.summary: Asda cut its operational carbon emissions by 12.8 percent in 2025. The supermarket chain states this brings its total reduction to 55 percent since 2015, exceeding its original target to halve emissions within a decade. The decade has officially concluded.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz shifts carbon neutral targets to 2049
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has dropped its goal of a carbon neutral new car fleet by 2039. The company now aims for a 90 percent production cut and an 80 percent use-phase reduction by 2039, with a net zero goal set for 2049. The timeline has been extended.
